deployment.description: Free-text label of the deployment this binding describes.

tool.description: What the host invokes: an MCP server/tool, a CLI, an endpoint.

data_sources.description: required_data_sources name (as written in playbook frontmatter) -> available to the executor

data_source_notes.description: required_data_sources name -> why it is unavailable or limited; printed with the visibility gap

source_profiles.description: source identifier -> the source profile of that technology, named from the tool skill that holds it ("<tool skill>/source_profile.json"). It is looked for beside the binding file first, where a deployment's own copy wins, and then beside the installed skills. A profile says what the source's records mean in the framework's terms; it is validated against source_profile.schema.json. A deployment that names none has no profile, which is a visibility gap and not an error.

source_profile_overrides.description: source identifier -> a local override laid over that source's profile (a path next to the binding file), validated against source_profile_override.schema.json. The shipped profile is the default and a deployment normally names none: an override unblocks a tenant when the source changes a field or a word before the shipped profile follows, holds only what differs, and is recorded on the ledger and in the Case's provenance of every run read through it.
